meaning: Independently verify actual nested Rule calls at source-selected owned factory lifecycle boundaries, without trusting the generated factory's reported validator trace.
input: Registered checked graph, reconciled plan and complete boundary inventory, and exact definition bytes. Preserve Entity identity versus Value Object equality, structural/owned field carriers and selected base/extension validator bindings.

source_protocol.calls: Reuse source-derived factory lifecycle cases. For each invocation whose source normalization and previous-ownership checks reach validators, bind normalized field/path facts to the selected validator's declared Rule parameters. Interpret original source Rules, record every nested call in entry order with parent index, named normalized arguments and Boolean result, and preserve first failure. Repeated validator occurrences remain distinct.
source_protocol.boundaries: Observe the requested create/reconstruct/transition/extend invocation only. Helpers for constructing inputs, previous snapshots, copies and foreign values are separate non-protocol activity. Invalid fields/previous/extension produce no target Rule calls. Identity-change rejection follows source-selected validation, not a validator bypass.
source_protocol.sensitivity: Every selected root or transitive Rule and every base/extension validator occurrence must be visited in target calls. The family must exhibit accepted construction and Rule-based rejection. Retain actual finite Boolean outcomes per occurrence; a validator can be always true over valid owned inputs because a nested Value Object already enforces it. Do not fabricate an invalid owned witness to force false. Unvisited occurrences, missing family outcome diversity, witness capacity or unavailable owned input retain the whole factory as not_evaluable, never a passing prefix; this is not an unreachable or unsatisfiable proof. Every selected factory-to-Rule and Rule-to-Rule import edge must have a source-predicted call whose exact parent identifies that importer. A Rule visited through a different parent cannot cover an unvisited edge. Retain per-edge visit counts; any unvisited selected edge keeps the entire family not_evaluable.
source_protocol.identity: Bind source-derived factory and Rule module paths/callables, full static root closure, exact module hashes and import edges. Required named-value modules may participate in input construction but are not thereby covered by the factory-to-Rule protocol.

native_protocol.runtime: Private instrumented CommonJS native lane. Compile captured original generated TypeScript with pinned tools. Wrap exported original Rule functions; never replace their predicates with expected answers.
native_protocol.trace: Capture only within the exact target lifecycle call; serialize descriptor-checked inert named argument facts, entry order, parent index, arity and Boolean result. Retain actual factory outcomes, ownership/lifecycle checks, getter counts and input fingerprints.
native_protocol.probe: Pass recipes, structural declarations and native bindings only. Exclude source expected outcomes, expected traces and helper witness expectations from the child payload.
native_protocol.comparison: Require exact inert complete observations: control identity, ordered rows/cases, outcomes, traces and non-mutation metrics. Missing, duplicate, reordered, foreign or active data rejects.
native_protocol.unavailable: An empty executable probe is not a passing family.

coverage: Account for every static boundary edge. Select only source-bound factory-to-Rule edges and transitively observed Rule-to-Rule edges. Leave named-value/Enum/native-library and other consumer protocols distinct. Static closure membership is not invocation proof.
verification: Native positive and invalid lifecycle cases in both configured module roots.
Nested Rules, named Value Object field paths, UInt64, list/set/optional/sum fields and extension ordering where source contracts support them.
Strict-TypeScript-compiling argument, predicate, omitted/duplicate/reordered Rule call mutants that cannot be hidden by reported validator traces.
Exact observation rejection, whole-family sensitivity/capacity, distinct setup versus target calls and unchanged prior semantic regressions.
exclusions: This unit does not add the factory family to the private custody executor or public capsule. Independent factory native-surface audit, retained source/artifact/tool custody and public integration remain required follow-on construction. No generator change, database interpretation, Event/provider execution, release or authority.
claim_ceiling: Finite private source-predicted versus instrumented native factory-to-Rule witnesses only. No universal purity, uninstrumented equivalence, atomic isolation, cross-generator completion or goal completion.
